relevance_note: Population/kinship study of six Piauí (Brazil) families with FLD; one person, the first case, is described individually ("bilateral corneal opacity in a young woman with nephrotic proteinuria and dyslipidemia"), and all six index cases carry homozygous LCAT c.803G > A, p.R268H.
method_note: Hand extraction, no table transcription (Table 1 holds only family-level inbreeding statistics). Only one person gets a row: the first FLD case in Piauí described in the Introduction (a young woman; labelled 'unnamed person 1' under rule 6 since the paper is not a single-patient case report). She is taken to be one of the six index cases because the paper says her case 'led to' five additional cases and the abstract reports six index cases; her variant (c.803G > A, p.R268H) and homozygosity come from statements about the named group of six index cases ('All six index cases were confirmed...'; 'molecular confirmation of homozygosity in the index cases'). The other five index cases, the 7 newly diagnosed homozygous relatives (13 homozygous total, 11 female, 2 male), 52 heterozygous and 6 noncarrier relatives are described only as counts/group statements or in the pedigree figure (Fig. 1, not available as text), so they get no rows. The statement that the five additional cases 'had the same clinical characteristics as the first case, with variations in the glomerular filtration rate from normal to stage 5' is group-level and was not used. Transcript NM_000229.1 is from the Methods description of the genetic diagnosis, not printed beside the variant. Family label of the first case (F01-F06) is not stated. 'Nephrotic proteinuria' recorded as proteinuria only; nephrotic syndrome left not reported. The paper calls her diagnosis 'unpublished data'; no prior report cited. No internal contradictions noted.
